name: Warcraft Reborn Improved Revenge makes Revenge strike an additional target
contract: Issue 8370: Improved Revenge's additional strike never happened. Reborn Revenge (1106572 rank 1 .. 1157823 rank 9) has EffectChainTarget 0, stock Revenge has 1.
Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets chains only when ChainTarget + SPELLMOD_JUMP_TARGETS > 1.
Improved Revenge 1112797 / 1112799 effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER JUMP_TARGETS base 1 die 1 = +2, so Revenge reaches 2 targets: the target plus one additional target, as the tooltip says.
